title: Right to Examine: Free-Look Cancellation of Whole Life Insurance
content:
**Right.** The owner may return a new Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy for a full refund of all premium paid.

**Time limit.** The returned policy must be received no later than the policy delivery date plus the tier's free-look days. The free-look end is found by adding the free-look days in calendar days to the policy delivery date; a policy received on that day is in time. When the sale replaced existing coverage, the tier's replacement free-look period replaces the free-look days. The delivery date and whether the sale replaced existing coverage are read from the policy record.

**Conversions.** A policy issued by conversion of an Ashgrove term policy has no free-look right, because the term coverage it replaced cannot be restored.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Tier | Delivered | Replacement sale | Free-look end | Received | In time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paid-Up at 100 (10 days) | June 1 | No | June 11 | June 11 | Yes |
| Paid-Up at 100 (10 days) | June 1 | No | June 11 | June 12 | No |
| Paid-Up at 100 (30 days on replacement) | June 1 | Yes | July 1 | June 25 | Yes |
| Any tier | Issued by conversion | | No free-look right | | |
